title: Yash (actor)
wiki_lead:
Yash (pronounced [/yah-sh/]; born Naveen Kumar, 8 January 1986) is an Indian actor and film producer who works in Kannada films. Known for his work in mass hero films, he is referred to as "Rocking Star" in the media. One of the highest-paid actors of Kannada cinema, Yash is a recipient of several accolades including three Filmfare Awards South and five SIIMA Awards. 
Yash began his career with appearances in several television series in the 2000s. He made his film debut in 2007 with Jambada Hudugi. The 2008 romantic drama Moggina Manasu, for which he received the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor, proved to be a breakthrough role for Yash.
His first film in a leading role, Rocky (2008), was poorly received by critics and a box office flop. Yash went on to establish himself as a leading actor of Kannada cinema with Googly, Raja Huli (both 2013), Gajakesari, Mr & Mrs Ramachari (both 2014), Masterpiece (2015) and Santhu Straight Forward (2016), all of which became commercial successes. The pan-India success of Prashanth Neel's KGF duology which consists of KGF: Chapter 1 (2018) and KGF: Chapter 2 (2022), helped Yash attain nationwide recognition. The former earned him the Filmfare Award for Best Actor – Kannada and the latter ranks as the highest-grossing Kannada film worldwide.
Yash is a philanthropist and promotes social causes through the Yasho Marga Foundation, a charitable foundation established by him and his wife. In addition to acting, he is a prominent celebrity endorser of several brands and products. He is married to actress Radhika Pandit, with whom he has two children.

Early life and career
Yash was born in Boovanahalli, a village in Hassan, Karnataka, India. He was given two names: Naveen legally, and his mother's side of the family named him Yashwanth. Yashwanth was chosen as they believed his time of birth astrologically necessitated a name beginning with the letter ಯ (ya). In keeping with a Hindu tradition of giving children a deity's epithet, Yash was described as Nanjundeshwara ("poison-drinker god", referring to Shiva). Before starting his acting career, he was advised by others in the industry to adopt a stage name. Desiring to stand out with a name that was unique, he shortened Yashwanth to Yash.
Yash's father, Arun Kumar, was a driver for the Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation and later the Bangalore Metropolitan Transport Corporation. His mother, Pushpa, is a homemaker. He has a younger sister, Nandini, who is married to a computer engineer. Yash aspired to be an actor from a young age and actively participated in theatre and dance competitions at his school in Mysore. When he was young, his family also ran a provision store, where he would help out regularly. Yash wanted to quit school and pursue full-time acting after completing grade 10 but had to complete senior school at the demand of his parents. grok_lead: Naveen Kumar Gowda (born 8 January 1986), known professionally as Yash, is an Indian actor and film producer who predominantly works in Kannada-language cinema. Born in Bojjhenahalli village near Hassan, Karnataka, to a bus driver father and homemaker mother, Yash aspired to acting from a young age and began his career in theatre before debuting on television with the serial Nanda Gokula. He entered films with a supporting role in Jambada Hudugi (2007) and achieved breakthrough recognition with the romantic drama Moggina Manasu (2008), earning the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor â Kannada. Yash rose to stardom through lead roles in commercially successful films such as Googly (2013), Mr. and Mrs. Ramachari (2014), and Santhu Straight Forward (2016), establishing his image as a charismatic action hero. His portrayal of the ambitious gold smuggler Raja Krishnappa Bairya, known as Rocky, in the action thriller K.G.F: Chapter 1 (2018) marked a turning point, propelling him to national fame with the film's pan-Indian box-office success, followed by the even larger blockbuster K.G.F: Chapter 2 (2022), which became the highest-grossing Kannada film ever. The K.G.F. franchise earned Yash multiple accolades, including Filmfare Awards for Best Actor â Kannada, and the series received the National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Kannada. In his personal life, Yash married actress Radhika Pandit in 2016, with whom he has two children, and he has been involved in production through his banner NTR Productions, though his family faced past allegations of financial irregularities in chit fund schemes, which Yash publicly denied.
